spec_features.feature_name: cost guardrails (max_turns / token caps / tool-output caps / dry-run-mock)
spec_features.spec_quote: Cost guardrails: hard `max_turns`, token caps, tool-output caps, and a `--dry-run`/mock mode
spec_features.evidence: max_turns enforced (agent.py:80,163). tool_output_char_cap enforced via _cap on read_file/run_tests/run_command (tools.py:148-152, 172, 193, 213; cap default 8000 config.py:47). mock mode enforced (config.mock -> make_client(spec, mock) in llm.py:195-197, runner.py). HOWEVER token cap (run_token_budget) defaults to 0=disabled (config.py:62, default.yaml) though its check at agent.py:157-162 does fire when set; and there is NO `--dry-run` flag (only `--mock`).
spec_features.notes: Most components enforced; token cap off by default (mechanism present), no separate --dry-run. Counts as partial because the claim bundles components, one of which (token cap) is disabled by default and the '--dry-run' is absent.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Cap each tool result so context stays bounded across many turns.
